correctness.rationale: The algebra automorphisms are canonically AGL(2), proved from the decomposition k⊕V⊕Λ²V and the nondegenerate exterior pairing. The equations N²=M²=0, Na=Mb=0, NM=MN, Nb=Ma follow from direct affine multiplication. Every commuting pair of 2-by-2 square-zero matrices has a common image/kernel line when a matrix is nonzero, while N=M=0 yields the four-dimensional translation component. The projective-line incidence bundle O(-2)^2⊕O(-1)^2 proves a 5-dimensional irreducible scroll cone, its smoothness away from zero and degree six. Intersection is the 3-dimensional rank-one 2-by-2 determinantal cone. Both branches are smooth off their intersection, and distinct components meet along the intersection, proving the precise singular locus. Fiber counting gives q⁵+2q⁴−q³−q². Direct finite-field checkers of actual affine pairs and actual exterior-algebra automorphisms pass for q=2,4 and the affine checker q=8; finite checks are corroborative rather than infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The full matrix commuting-square-zero variety in Levy 2006 is broader in ambient objects but its equidimensionality does not imply the geometry of this constrained affine slice. Britnell–Wildon classify similarity-class commuting types, Ngo treats different Lie algebra commuting tuple invariants under different characteristic hypotheses, and Baek–Han studies group graph distances. Seven semantic published-record queries and comparisons with 105 accessible historical claim records retrieved no equivalent/dominating result. This is best-knowledge, provisional historical originality, with possible unknown general parabolic representation-variety coverage.

value.rationale: The representation variety Hom((Z/2Z)²,Aut(k[x,y]/(x²,y²))) in characteristic two is a natural moduli invariant of automorphisms of a minimal nonsemisimple local algebra. The scroll/translation-component structure, dimension jump and full reduced singular locus give geometric information not contained in ambient equidimensionality or isolated finite-field enumeration, with a uniform point count over all binary extension fields. Its non-equidimensionality under an affine constraint delineates a structural boundary of unrestricted matrix commuting results.
